references.context: Set theory and ring theory: intersection of a family of ideal subsets in a ring

references.disposition: The intersection is over all maximal proper ideals, not all prime ideals and not a single chosen ideal.

review_rationale: Read the commutative-ring Jacobson radical as intersection of every maximal ideal of R. Kept maximal ideals distinct from the nilradical or radical ideals, and interpreted intersection set-theoretically.
